featured.title: Powerful 7.7 Earthquake Strikes Indonesia
featured.content: A powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off eastern Indonesia early Saturday, followed by several aftershocks. Authorities issued a tsunami warning while emergency agencies assessed the situation and monitored coastal areas for possible waves and further seismic activity.

articles.title: France Court Blocks Under-15 Social Media Ban
articles.description: France's top court has blocked legislation that would have banned social-media access for children under 15. The ruling found that the measure infringed on freedom of expression, reigniting debate over online safety and children's protection.

articles.description: EasyJet cabin crew in France are scheduled to strike on August 15 and 16 over working conditions. The industrial action could affect passengers travelling during the busy European summer holiday period.

articles.title: Nigeria's July Oil Production Falls
articles.description: Nigeria's crude oil production averaged around 1.505 million barrels per day in July, down approximately 4 percent from June following disruptions affecting offshore operations.
